notes.title: UPDATE 02.04.2018
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has bought the very early access of the game and reported some of the problems they were experiencing. We have made some major changes, making the game a much better experience. However, we still have a long way to go due to the thousands of elements that need to be added and improved upon. Our vision, regardless, is still to create a fully functioning city. We have had additional programmers join the project in order to develop the game much faster.

Some of the main developments include:

- properly working weapons

- sounds

- new environments (diner, casino, go-kart racing, two apartments, gunshop)

- new characters

- cars driving around the city

- money, hunger and time system

- less motion sickness
